Title: Some questions form a confused player

Messages.Author: Guru
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have some questions concerning timing in VTES:

1) Karimana Benghazi has a Magnum on her. Player controlling her has
untapped Heidelburg Castle. His predator plays Anachronism on
Karimana. Can a player tap HC in 'response' to Anachronism? Or not?
What with Constantin, Baro of the Caravan special ability? He declares
using it, can I tap HC in response? If so, what happens to Baro, does
his action fizzles?

2) Can a wampire with OBF in torpor play Cloak the Gathering at
superior?

3) What happens when I play successfully a Seeds of Corruption card on
Karimana Benghazi with some counters on her (from her special
ability)? Does the player controlling her have to discard cards and
have original hand size till she gets back?

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Guru wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I have some questions concerning timing in VTES:
>
> 1) Karimana Benghazi has a Magnum on her. Player controlling her has
> untapped Heidelburg Castle. His predator plays Anachronism on
> Karimana. Can a player tap HC in 'response' to Anachronism? Or not?

No time. Anachronism resolves immmediately (like most cards)

> What with Constantin, Baro of the Caravan special ability? He declares
> using it, can I tap HC in response? If so, what happens to Baro, does
> his action fizzles?

You can't tap HC during an action (card text). After the action is
declared it has already begun, so you can't use the HC.

> 2) Can a wampire with OBF in torpor play Cloak the Gathering at
> superior?

No, card text ('Usable by a ready vampire...')

> 3) What happens when I play successfully a Seeds of Corruption card on
> Karimana Benghazi with some counters on her (from her special
> ability)? Does the player controlling her have to discard cards and
> have original hand size till she gets back?

I'd say yes, but precedent by Tegyrius seems to suggest that the
counters themselves increase the hand size, regardless of her special
being active (ie, the last sentence on her special defines the
properties of the counters, and those are not affected by Seeds).

LSJ?

Flux
